sources.revision: Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §24.2.2.1–.4, public official PDF reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The specification describes the DataStorage segment-index map, DataIndex references, handle-keyed records, blob descriptors, and Blob01 page headers/lengths. It does not define ACIS topology or consumer semantics.
sources.limits: The public specification remains the format authority. Its §24 segment-index description does not expressly establish a general non-overlapping physical-extent rule for every stale/aliased segment entry.

sources.revision: v3.7.1 tag d7dc111; fetched source blob SHA 66653e550d82f05226e48ec6a3848c58acca2f25
sources.observed: GetSchemaData joins schema-search entries to data entries by handle. ResolveDataEntry selects Blob01 segments using descriptor segment indexes, sorts them by page index, and concatenates page bytes; the descriptor tuple's per-page size is not consumed by that accessor.
sources.limits: This accessor behavior does not prove that all lower-level parser validations are absent, and it is not an observed incorrect output. It does mean the accessor's returned byte array alone cannot serve as evidence that descriptor page-size metadata was checked end to end.

decision.planDelta: Verified that merged ACadSharp PR #1154 is included in signed v3.7.1 source and corrected the peer's status to an optional released structured DWG comparator. Narrowed its high-level Blob01 evidence: ResolveDataEntry orders referenced pages by ordinal and concatenates bytes but does not consume descriptor page sizes, so raw descriptor/page metadata must be independently captured for structural comparison. Local generated parser/test coverage already validates these cases; no duplicate test or code change is warranted. Physical segment extent overlap remains a conditional audit question until the normative/producer rule is established. No new support claim or external blocker.

implementationReadyChecks: If one specific local DataStorage question remains after generated controls, pin ACadSharp v3.7.1 source/package, runtime, operation, and input hash and use it once as an optional structural/association comparator.

For Blob01 comparisons, capture DataIndex row, record handle, descriptor page count and per-reference sizes, referenced segment indexes, each page's ordinal/start/count/actual length, complete byte hash, owner join, and strict parse outcome; do not use the high-level returned byte array alone as proof of metadata validity.
Reuse the existing generated Blob01 fast selector if that parser code changes; do not add a duplicate CTest or persistent external DWG/DXF fixture.
Do not reject physically overlapping segment extents without authoritative or producer evidence that disjointness is a required invariant; preserve legitimate stale-secondary-index compatibility.
Keep OpenCADStudio's issue as a same-lineage failure lead and keep stock FreeCAD import separate from ACIS/AcDs semantics.
If the optional peer or native route is not available, record NOT_QUALIFIED once and self-unblock to the next source-backed local item without waiting on external qualification.
